native_payload.intent: Behavior-preserving refactor of soba to clear 13 SonarQube findings: decompose high-complexity functions in internal/backup.go into helpers, extract backup-status titles into constants plus a backupStatusTitle helper in notify.go, remove duplicate test TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 and simplify TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup, and tidy docker/Dockerfile (merged RUNs, sorted apk packages, quoted TAG URL). Stated contract: behavior and log output unchanged.
residual_risks: createWorkingDir (internal/backup.go:473-478) repeats the GIT_WORKING_DIR lookup and default already in resolveWorkingDir (internal/backup.go:140-146). The duplication predates this diff and was moved verbatim; calling resolveWorkingDir would keep startup creation and cleanup from drifting. Informational.

collectProviderBackupResults short-circuits bitbucketAPITokenDefined() || bitbucketOAuthDefined(). When API-token creds are complete and an OAuth *_FILE var points at a missing file, the per-run 'file ... does not exist' log line from GetEnvOrFile is no longer emitted (it still appears at startup via checkProvidersDefined). This is a small deviation from the stated 'log output unchanged' contract; cosmetic only.
testing_gaps: checkJustTokenProvider / checkUserAndPasswordProvider (internal/backup.go): no test covers the partial-configuration error ('%s parameter '%s' is not defined.'), the blank-but-defined token branch, or the full-match return; the only caller test hits the all-unset path. A table-driven env test would pin the count and error text the split moved. The two Bitbucket credential predicates are pure env checks reachable only through skipped live-credential tests.

backupStatusTitle (internal/notify.go): new shared source for the ntfy, Slack and Telegram titles with three branches (success, partial failure, total failure incl. succeeded=0,failed=0) and no test; the preserved U+FE0F prefix in the error/failed titles could drift silently. Mirror a 3-case table test.

scheduleBackups / runScheduledJob / validateStartupConfig (internal/backup.go): interval and cron branches, the 'failed to create job' path, and the GITHUB_ORGS-without-token, missing backup directory and non-ENOENT stat error branches have no coverage; only the missing GIT_BACKUP_DIR error is tested. An invalid cron expression exercises runScheduledJob without blocking on signals.
